description: Accepted dependency-vulnerability exceptions for the DRISHTI hackathon-demo release (Prompt 22 D.2). The dependency-audit gate (scripts/security/dep_audit.py) BLOCKS on any high/critical finding NOT listed here, and warns when an exception is past its expiry. Each exception records the deployment-context mitigation, the owner, an expiry that forces re-review, and the concrete fix path. This is a synthetic-hackathon posture, never a production waiver.

npm.note: Shipped (production) npm dependencies are clean: `npm audit --omit=dev` reports 0 vulnerabilities. The 5 dev-toolchain findings (vite, vitest, @vitest/mocker, vite-node, esbuild) are build/test-only, are NOT emitted into the static browser bundle, and the high/critical ones require running the dev/test server AND visiting a malicious site. They are therefore out of the shipped-artifact scope; tracked for a dev-toolchain bump.

applicability: CVE-2026-48818 (StaticFiles UNC SSRF) is Windows-only; AppSail deploys on linux/amd64 and DRISHTI serves NO StaticFiles from user-controlled paths.

CVE-2025-54121 (multipart spool) + CVE-2026-54283 (request.form bounds): the AppSail API is JSON-only; it does not parse untrusted multipart form uploads (evidence objects use Catalyst Stratus / S3 pre-signed URLs, not multipart through Starlette).
CVE-2025-62727 (FileResponse Range quadratic DoS): DRISHTI does not serve user-controlled FileResponse with Range headers from AppSail.

CVE-2026-48710 + CVE-2026-54282 (Host/path used to rebuild request.url): DRISHTI authorization uses the signed gateway context, never request.url host/path; all traffic is fronted by the Catalyst API Gateway which validates Host and caps request size/rate.
CVE-2026-48817 (HTTPEndpoint handler lowercasing): DRISHTI routes are APIRouter function endpoints, not case-varying HTTPEndpoint classes.
pip_exceptions.severity_note: Advisories are DoS or feature-specific and are not exploitable in the DRISHTI AppSail deployment context (linux, JSON API, behind the Catalyst API Gateway, synthetic-only data).
pip_exceptions.mitigation: Catalyst API Gateway request validation + size/rate caps; single-instance AppSail; synthetic-only data; no untrusted multipart/StaticFiles/FileResponse-Range surface.
pip_exceptions.fix_path: Upgrade fastapi to >=0.139.2 and starlette to >=1.3.1 (crosses the starlette 1.0 major) in a tested maintenance window; deferred here because the cross-major framework upgrade cannot be landed AND regression-verified safely within Prompt 22 without risking the working 378-test backend. Re-evaluated at Prompt 25 (final release).
